purpose: Provenance for docs/contract.json. VCF Automation ships no machine-readable API specification, so the contract was transcribed by hand from the pages listed here. Every page below was fetched over the public internet on the recorded date.
product: VCF Automation, VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 (successor to vRealize Automation and Aria Automation)
reference_set: VM Apps Org - Provisioning Service, titled "VMware Aria Automation Assembler IaaS API" on the Broadcom Developer Portal

specification_repository_checked.result: No VCF Automation specification is published there. The repository carries SDDC Manager, VCF Operations and related component specs; the Automation IaaS surface is absent. Checked 2026-08-11.
specification_repository_checked.consequence: docs/contract.json is reference-derived. It is not generated from, and is not a substitute for, a vendor OpenAPI document.

pages.page_title: VMware Aria Automation Assembler IaaS API Operations Index
pages.documents: Operation inventory. Used to confirm that the three operations this contract names exist in the 9.1 reference set, and to confirm their methods and paths: GET /iaas/api/regions/{id} (Get Region), GET /iaas/api/fabric-vsphere-datastores/{id} (Get Fabric vSphere Datastore), POST /iaas/api/storage-profiles-vsphere (Create vSphere Storage Profile).

Authentication for every operation in this reference set. States type apiKey, name Authorization, in header. The page does not document a value prefix; see contract.authentication.transcription_status.

Operation getRegion: GET /iaas/api/regions/{id}. Source for the path parameter, the optional apiVersion query parameter, the 200/403/404 response codes, and the Region field list (id, createdAt, updatedAt, owner, ownerType, orgId, _links, externalRegionId, name, cloudAccountId).

Operation getFabricVsphereDatastore: GET /iaas/api/fabric-vsphere-datastores/{id}. Source for the path parameter, the optional apiVersion and $select query parameters, and the 200/403/404 response codes.

Operation createVsphereStorageProfile: POST /iaas/api/storage-profiles-vsphere. Source for the optional apiVersion query parameter, the required Authorization and Content-Type: application/json headers, the StorageProfileVsphereSpecification request body, and the documented response codes 201 (VsphereStorageProfile), 400 and 403 (ServiceErrorResponse). Note that no 404 is documented for this operation.

Request body schema for createVsphereStorageProfile. Source for the required/optional split on every body field and for the field descriptions quoted in the contract, including "Defines the priority of the storage class with the highest priority being 0. Defaults to 1." and the note that datastoreId is deprecated in favour of storageProfileAssociations.

201 response body for createVsphereStorageProfile. Source for the returned field list, including that the response reports externalRegionId and cloudAccountId rather than echoing the submitted regionId.

200 response body for getFabricVsphereDatastore. Source for the field list and for the two descriptions the precheck rule leans on: externalRegionId is "Id of datacenter in which the datastore is present." and cloudAccountIds is "Set of ids of the cloud accounts this entity belongs to."
Error body shared by the non-2xx responses of all three operations. Fields: message, messageId, stackTrace, statusCode, errorCode, details, serverErrorId, documentKind, internalErrorCode.
Element type of the tags and tagsToMatch arrays. Fields: key (required), value (required), id (optional).

not_fetched.note: No standalone data-structures/Region/ page was fetched. The Region field list in the contract comes from the response section of the Get Region operation page listed above, and is scoped to the fields that page shows.
